# What fuse-figma's `test:capture` capture check reads, as git pathspecs, one per line. The merge
# workflow's figma-capture job captures only when one of these changed since its base

# test/merge-task-graph.test.mjs checks that every package the task's turbo graph builds is listed.
# Its unit tests and the plugin's fake-file Plan differential run in the job, so they count.
